Package com.hkust.marketplace.data

Class DataCipher

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.data.DataCipher
public final class DataCipher extends Object
Encrypts saved files so they are never stored as readable plain text (the data and every listing's information must be "securely stored").

Uses AES-GCM from the JDK, which also detects any change to an encrypted file: a file that was edited, damaged or encrypted with another key fails to decrypt instead of giving wrong data. A file is: "HKMP1" (format marker) + 12-byte random nonce + ciphertext and tag.

Key. The key is built into the code (team decision, see the assumptions register): it is derived from DEFAULT_PASSPHRASE, so every copy of the app can read files saved by any other copy, and anyone with the source code could decrypt them. Changing the passphrase makes old files unreadable.
